text:
Morgan: quick sync request — we need to align vendor roadmaps (NVIDIA H100/H200/B200, AMD MI300, Habana Gaudi) + marketplace timing before the end of next quarter. who can do a 30m working session next week?

Jess: @Morgan I can make time. do we want vendors on the call or just an internal prep first?

Morgan: internal prep first, then a joint 1hr with vendor PMs. goal: map out compatibility windows, image/driver requirements, and announcement/marketplace launch windows.

Rahul: from perf/ML side: MI300 availability timelines we heard are still soft (Q3->Q4 variability). H200 samples expected earlier but firmware/driver stability might lag. we should capture: sample dates, perf deltas vs H100, expected quantization/TF32 behavior.

Claire: also add marketing constraints — marketplace listing requires 2 weeks of compliance doc review + an image validation run (we need to know when we can spin images). if vendors want joint PR, they usually need 4-6 week notice.

Sam: infra checklist: kernel/drivers, cuda/rocm versions, device-plugin updates, and our autoscaler tests. Sam: suggest we run a quick compatibility matrix: 
```
vendor | driver target | kernel | image tag
NVIDIA  | cuda 12.x    | 5.15+  | rdl/h200-2026-rc1
AMD     | rocm5.x      | 5.15+  | rdl/mi300-preview
Gaudi   | gaudi-sdk    | 5.15+  | rdl/gaudi-alpha
```

Morgan: perfect. for internal prep let's capture vendor commitments into one doc. I'll draft an agenda: 1) vendor timelines 2) infra gaps 3) marketplace/PR windows 4) rollout/phased support 5) owner assignments.

Jess: bump — sample list from vendors: H100->H200 delta matrix, B200 availability (cloud partners), MI300 SKUs, Gaudi perf/TCO notes. @Rahul can you start a short prompt benchmark plan we can use for image validation?

Rahul: on it. I'll baseline H100 and MI300 on our standard gen/chat and embeddings workloads. will need ~48 GPU-hours per vendor.

Claire: ops question — if we align on joint announcement for H200 GA in Nov, is that realistic given the 4-6 week PR prep + 2 weeks listing? timeline math says we need vendor confirmation by early Oct.

Sam: noted. infra ramp: we can prioritize H200 images first, then MI300, Gaudi last. capacity-wise we can reserve a small pool for validation starting Oct 10.

Morgan: proposed times for internal prep: Tue 9/29 11:00am PT or Thu 10/1 3:00pm PT. please react or reply with preferences.

deploy-bot: Meeting poll created: Tue 2026-09-29 11:00 PT / Thu 2026-10-01 15:00 PT — vote at: https://cal.link/rdl-gpu-sync (added by Morgan) :calendar:

Jess: voted Tue 11am.

Rahul: Tue works. I'll upload initial benchmark plan by EOD today.

Claire: voted Tue. I'll start drafting PR checklist and add it to the shared doc.

Morgan: thanks — I'll create the shared doc and capture vendor ask list. will ping vendor contacts after internal prep so we can get their committed dates. :thumbsup:
